title: T1681 — Search Threat Vendor Data
subtitle: Watch how a published vendor report triggers an infrastructure reset, and why a defender who trusts a stale indicator list loses sight of the attacker.
aria: A vendor publishes attacker indicators, the attacker finds the report, rotates infrastructure and takes down exposed domains, while defenders update intel and hunt behaviorally
